rights_and_promises.category: land reservation under treaty, not automatically a fulfilled federal payment

rights_and_promises.term: 29 sections for designated Muscogee recipients and separate named grant provisions
Additional $12,000 yearly for five years and $10,000 yearly for fifteen years
$100,000 to pay Muscogee debts/relief, considered full payment for certain improvements
Specified claims $3,000 ferries/bridges; $8,570 judgments; $7,710 claimed losses; $1,000 improvements

muscogee_land.warning: Treaty promises are obligations recorded in the treaty but historical payments and superseding agreements must be checked before computing outstanding debt.

scenario_not_claim.assumption: Treat every person in reconstructed 1832 enslaved population as one whole life and assign modern 2024 $13.1m VSL as a normative endowment; not empirical value of slavery losses
scenario_not_claim.reason_no_compounding: Neither VSL nor estimated population headcount is accrued unpaid 1832-dollar compensation; retroactive interest would mix eras and assumptions.
